note: LaTeX builds Ł and ł from character 32 of the text font, a stroke, and an L or an l. TeX set them cleanly, and then dvi2html failed with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toString')": its glyph map has no entry for the stroke, in any of the text fonts. Fixed by the build's patch to dvi2html (scripts/dvi2html-patch.mjs).
